comparison.objective: Release a tool from a spring jaw while retaining it and keeping a loose fixture in place, unlike changing a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-jaw opening, tool retention, and fixture counterholding; candidate adds recessed-key use, precise collar tuning, tightening torque, and cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Tool released and retained while fixture stays put; opening/counterholding are optional, and numeric motion, force, drop, and damage limits are not stated.
comparison.reason: Shared counterholding and release primitives do not establish overlap: this tests extraction without disturbing supports, not calibration and lock integrity.
